items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Because he was crazy about King Oliver.

ctx.x: Because he was crazy about King Oliver. Yeah, that's right. And he was a great big black man. He played with a lot of those dark people. That's right. He's my son, he's the best man, talking about his last single minutes of... But he took communion and he... He's a free man. Last... Last... Two minutes of being a bachelorhood. I told him, boy, you better hurry up out of here. Because he looked like he was going to be late for his own wedding. That's her sister that lives in New York. Oh, yes. Here she comes down…
